mission_vision.Our Mission: At Balmiki Lincoln College, our mission is to foster intellectually curious, ethically grounded, and globally competent individuals by combining academic excellence with innovation and real-world learning—empowering students to lead with purpose in an ever-evolving world.

mission_vision.Our Vision: To be a premier hub of academic excellence and innovation—shaping future-ready graduates who drive positive change, champion ethical leadership, and make meaningful contributions to the global community.

mission_vision.Our Values: We are guided by integrity, innovation, inclusivity, and a commitment to lifelong learning—values that shape our community and inspire excellence in everything we do.

academic_program.description: The Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons) (BBA.Hons) is a prestigious and highly sought-after undergraduate degree designed to build a strong foundation in business, leadership, and management skills

The Bachelor of Hotel Management (Hons) (BHM.Hons) is a dynamic and industry-relevant undergraduate degree program tailored for students aspiring to build successful careers in the hospitality and tourism industry

content.our_story: OUR STORY Empowering Education for the Future Established with a commitment to academic excellence and practical learning, Balmiki LincolnCollege has grown to become a center for innovation, research, and holistic education. From humble beginnings, we’ve evolved into a dynamic institution recognized for preparing graduates who make a global impact. 2000: Founding Founded with a mission to transform education in Nepal through global partnerships. 2008: International Partnership Launched our first international undergraduate program with Lincoln University College, Malaysia. 2016: Academic Expansion Expanded academic offerings with new programs in technology and management fields. 2024: National Recognition Ranked among Nepal’s leading colleges for international-standard higher education.

content.program_overview: Program Overview The Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons) (BBA.Hons) program at Balmiki Lincoln College, affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia, is a comprehensive undergraduate degree designed to equip students with a strong foundation in business principles, management practices, and entrepreneurial skills. Our curriculum prepares graduates for diverse roles across various industries. This four-year program blends theoretical knowledge with practical application, emphasizing critical thinking, problem-solving, and leadership development. Students gain insights into key business functions such as marketing, finance, human resources, and operations, ensuring they are well-prepared for entry-level management positions or further postgraduate studies. This globally recognized degree ensures you are ready for both local and international career opportunities. Affiliation This program is proudly affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia, a reputable institution known for its commitment to academic excellence and industry-focused education. This affiliation ensures our students receive a high-quality, internationally benchmarked curriculum and a degree that is respected globally.
content.program_features_career: Program Features & Career Paths Discover what makes our BBA program unique and the exciting career opportunities awaiting you upon graduation. Key Program Highlights Industry-Relevant Curriculum Covers core business functions and emerging trends, ensuring you learn skills demanded by today's employers. Practical & Experiential Learning Includes case studies, business simulations, and projects that provide hands-on experience and build analytical skills. Holistic Development Fosters leadership qualities, communication skills, and ethical decision-making for well-rounded professionals. Entrepreneurial Mindset Encourages innovative thinking and provides tools for those aspiring to start and manage their own ventures. Career Opportunities A BBA degree provides a versatile foundation, opening doors to a wide range of entry-level and mid-level roles across various industries. Our graduates are prepared for positions such as: Marketing Executive / Coordinator Financial Analyst (Entry-level) Human Resources Associate Operations Supervisor / Coordinator Business Development Representative Sales Executive Project Assistant Data Analyst (Business) Retail Manager Customer Service Manager Small Business Owner
content.admission_requirement: Admission Requirements Prospective students for the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) program must meet the following criteria to ensure their readiness for our rigorous academic environment: Academic Qualification: Completion of 10+2 or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks (or a minimum GPA of 2.0 on a 4.0 scale) in any discipline, preferably Management or Commerce streams. English Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency in English (e.g., a good score in IELTS/TOEFL if not from an English-medium academic background, or equivalent college assessment). Entrance Examination: Successful completion of the college's entrance examination, which may cover Mathematics, English, and General Knowledge. Interview: A successful interview with the college's admissions committee. For detailed information on admission procedures, required documents, and application deadlines, please visit our Admissions page or contact our admissions office.

content.program_overview: Program Overview The Master of Business Administration (MBA) program at Balmiki Lincoln College, affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia, is a rigorous and transformative postgraduate degree designed for ambitious professionals seeking to advance into strategic leadership roles. This intensive two-year program (4 semesters) focuses on developing advanced business acumen, critical thinking, and executive decision-making skills. Our curriculum integrates theoretical foundations with practical, real-world challenges, offering specializations that cater to evolving industry demands. Graduates emerge as agile leaders, prepared to navigate complex global markets, drive innovation, and make a significant impact in diverse organizations or entrepreneurial ventures. This globally recognized degree from Lincoln University College, Malaysia serves as a powerful catalyst for career acceleration. Affiliation This program is proudly affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia, a reputable institution known for its commitment to academic excellence and industry-focused education. This affiliation ensures our students receive a high-quality, internationally benchmarked curriculum and a degree that is respected globally.

Our graduates are well-prepared for roles such as: Senior Management / General Manager Business Consultant Operations Director / Supply Chain Manager Financial Manager / Investment Analyst Marketing Director / Brand Manager Human Resources Director / Head of Talent Project Manager (Senior) Entrepreneur / Startup Founder Strategy Analyst International Business Manager Product Manager
content.admission_requirement: Admission Requirements Prospective students for the Master of Business Administration (MBA) program must meet the following criteria to ensure their readiness for our rigorous academic environment: Academic Qualification: Completion of a Bachelor's degree (minimum 3-4 years duration) from a recognized university, with a strong academic record (e.g., minimum 50% aggregate marks or GPA 2.5 on a 4.0 scale). Work Experience (Preferred): While not always mandatory, candidates with a minimum of 1-2 years of relevant professional work experience are often given preference. Entrance Examination: Successful completion of the college's MBA entrance examination, which may cover quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability, and general awareness. (Alternatively, a valid GMAT/GRE score might be accepted, please confirm with admissions). English Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency in English (e.g., a good score in IELTS/TOEFL if not from an English-medium academic background, or equivalent college assessment). Letters of Recommendation: Two (2) letters of recommendation, preferably one from an academic referee and one from a professional referee. Statement of Purpose (SOP): A well-written essay articulating your career goals, reasons for pursuing an MBA, and why you choose Balmiki Lincoln College. Interview: A successful interview with the college's admissions committee to assess your motivation, leadership potential, and communication skills. For detailed information on admission procedures, required documents, and application deadlines, please visit our Admissions page or contact our admissions office.

content.Library: Central Library Extensive Resources & Study Spaces At Balmiki Lincoln College, the library is the lifeblood of our academic community. It stands as a quiet and motivating space for research, study, and intellectual pursuit. We have carefully provided many resources, from a robust collection of books and journals to periodicals and academic databases, that cover each of the subjects taught at the college. The library provides our students with the necessary tools to be successful in their coursework, dive into in-depth research, and explore their particular interests outside of class. The library has been designed to be a welcoming and comfortable place for everyone. There are many study places and options, from individual study carrels for intense studying to large tables for group work. We provide high-speed access to the internet as well as computer terminals that our students can use to [digital] access resources and conduct online research. Our librarians can also assist with looking up the collection, provide research strategies, and assist students with finding the information they are seeking. The Balmiki Lincoln College library is more than just a collection of books - it is a powerful center for learning and a quiet place of sanctuary for academic freedom. Vast collection of books and journals Access to digital databases and e-resources Quiet study rooms and collaborative areas Dedicated research support and librarians Digital Resources Access a wealth of online journals, databases, and research tools for comprehensive learning and research. Online Access Study Zones Diverse study environments from quiet individual carrels to vibrant group collaboration areas with Wi-Fi. Varied Seating
content.Sports: Sports Complex & Courts State-of-the-Art Sports Facilities Balmiki Lincoln College acknowledges the important role sports and physical health have within a holistic education. The college has sport organized and facilities available for students to engage in physical activity, improve their skills, and develop a sense of community and competition. Through the college's sports programs and facilities available on campus, students are exposed to a variety of outdoor sports in large well-maintained grounds and indoor sports in dedicated facilities. Various sports are available for students to participate in at different levels of recreational engagement, competitive league, and club. Going beyond physical activity, participation in sports programs support character building and community. Along with the physical health benefits of participation, engagement in sports helps develop a variety of character skills and community through the lessons of teamwork, players support elements of leadership, discipline, and team work. Sports shows students time and time again to leverage similar skill sets in academics first through learning to take disciplined action and purpose with respect to time and develop lasting friendships through bonds with environments with students with shared engagements. Balmiki Lincoln College recognizes the strengths of physical activity to promote an engaged student environment for all students whether they have played sports primarily throughout their lives, are just starting out to experience a new sport, or are doing so with a sense of social connectivity. Multi-purpose sports courts (basketball, volleyball) Well-equipped fitness and gymnasium centers Indoor sports arenas for various activities Dedicated spaces for indoor games like table tennis Indoor Games Facilities for various indoor games like table tennis, chess, and carrom to enhance student engagement. Recreational Fun Athletic Center Experience our state-of-the-art athletic facilities designed to promote fitness, wellness, and high-performance training for every student. Well-equipped

Large open fields for general recreational use Landscaped gardens and seating areas Pathways for walking and light exercise Natural settings for outdoor contemplation Recreational Grounds Spacious grounds suitable for casual outdoor activities, student events, and various campus celebrations. Event Friendly Campus Gardens Beautifully maintained gardens offering tranquil spots for students to relax, read, or simply enjoy nature. Peaceful Retreats
content.Classrooms: Sports Complex & Courts State-of-the-Art Classroom Facilities Balmiki Lincoln College is committed to creating a contemporary learning environment that provides students with relevant skills and knowledge needed to be successful in today's world. Our classrooms are designed to be engaging and comfortable places to teach and learn. Our classrooms feature an air conditioning system that provides the optimal environment to work and concentrate all year long without regard for the season or weather in Birtamod. By helping students feel comfortable, we provide an environment that aids concentration and creative thinking all year long. Additionally, our classrooms have interactive smart boards-an advanced technology feature that replaces traditional systems of teaching (whiteboards and chalkboards). Smart boards provide professors with the means to consistently offer engaging and interactive lessons that bring the content to life. Professors can display digital content to their students, annotate their presentations in real-time, and integrate video and multimedia content into their lessons. The smart board allows students to collaboratively engage in discussions with professors and classmates, develop solutions collaboratively, and engage with complex subject matter in a dynamic way. By providing students with both a comfortable and innovative environment, Balmiki Lincoln College classrooms are designed to be not just places for lecture-style instruction but can offer students exploration and inquiry, and an engaging and intellectually enriching experience. Interactive Smart Boards for dynamic lessons Ergonomic seating and flexible classroom layouts High-speed internet and multimedia integration Air-conditioned, well-lit learning environments Collaborative Spaces Dedicated areas designed to promote group discussions, interactive projects, and peer-to-peer learning. Engaging Environments Digital Learning Tools State-of-the-art digital equipment including smart displays, interactive projectors, and easy-access tech. Tech-Enabled
content.Auditoriums: Campus Auditoriums Convenient & Comfortable Auditoriums The Auditorium at Balmiki Lincoln College is a newly constructed space that serves as a main venue for college-wide events and cultural programs. Equipped for the most current and leading-edge acoustics and sound and lighting, it hosts a variety of events: academic symposiums, guest speakers, student performances, annual rites, and more. It is our largest space, and serves as the assembly point for the college community where we come together to participate as a community, together, in whatever is taking place on campus. The Auditorium is more than a large space, it is a space where people demonstrate their talents and engage in important discussions. It hosts our annual Convocation ceremonies, competitions between colleges, and theatrical and musical productions. The seating in the Auditorium is comfortable, with the type of sight lines that allow all audience members good views of the stage. Each event hosted in the Auditorium is memorable and takes engagement to another level. The Balmiki Lincoln College Auditorium, is an expression of our efforts to provide a lively and full campus life that encourages engagement and community beyond the walls of the classroom. State-of-the-art audio-visual systems for clear presentations Ergonomic seating ensuring comfort during long events Advanced lighting and acoustics tailored for performances Versatile space configuration for multi-purpose events Advanced AV Systems High-quality sound and projection equipment ensures impactful presentations and shows. Immersive Experience Flexible Event Scheduling Adaptable seating and stage arrangements that cater to diverse events and performances. Customizable Layouts
content.Canteens: Canteen Convenient & Accessible Campus Canteen Balmiki Lincoln College also has a friendly and inviting canteen. The canteen is a center for students to come together, socialize, and replenish their energy. Our canteen offers an array of tasty, healthy, and inexpensive food options including snacks, light meals, and lunches. We source good quality fresh food, so that all students have the option to be well-fed and fueled throughout the day. The canteen is not simply a place to eat, but a community space to develop and share relationships and ideas in an informal and relaxed environment. We acknowledge the need to enhance the student experience, and we have developed an inviting canteen space to underpin that experience. The canteen has the space to be suitable for classmates in between classes, for students to catch up with friends, and even for students to enjoy the presence of their peers in a quiet moment over a good cup of coffee. The canteen is determined to provide students with a clean, safe, and welcoming atmosphere to enjoy, and is a major theme of Balmiki Lincoln College life. Wide Variety of Cuisines offering local and international flavors Affordable Pricing tailored for students and staff Fresh Daily Ingredients ensuring quality meals Comfortable Seating Arrangements for relaxed dining and study breaks Diverse Food Selection Enjoy an array of tasty dishes ranging from local favorites to international specialties, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Fresh Ingredients Comfortable Dining Area Relax and socialize in our cozy dining space designed with modern aesthetics and ergonomic seating. Cozy Ambience
content.Transport: Campus Transport Convenient & Accessible Campus Transport Balmiki Lincoln College understands the importance of reliable and suitable modes of transport for students to the college. Our focus is to enable students to arrive at the college on time, no matter where they are coming from. Maintaining effective systems for navigation is important towards helping students concentrate on their studies. We prioritize transportation and address any difficulties faced to make the college experience enjoyable. Different modes of transport are accessible for students, and they can be viewed to identify the best option to select, based on the individual’s needs. It is important to us that all Balmiki Lincoln College students are provided with suitable transport that can be easily accessed, regardless of their location. We urge you to examine all the options that are accessible to you and select the one that is best suited to your preferences and simplifies your daily routine. Dedicated college bus routes for students Ample and secure parking spaces for vehicles Accessible pathways and ramps across campus Proximity to public transport hubs Campus Bus Service Regular and safe bus services connecting students from various locations to the college. Daily Routes Parking Facilities Secure and spacious parking available for student and faculty vehicles within the campus premises. Designated Areas
content.Lab: Modern Laboratories Cutting-Edge & Specialized Laboratories Balmiki Lincoln College knows that practical, hands-on education is necessary to succeed in specific fields. That's why we have created separate fully equipped laboratories that meet the needs of our Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM) and our Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) programs. A variety of laboratories will ensure each student receives the specialized training and hands-on experience they need to have successful careers. Our BHM lab is designed with a hospitality focus; it has a training kitchen, a mock restaurant, and a front office. Students can learn to cook, practice food and beverage service, and explore hotel management operations under highly experienced faculty. Our BIT lab is a modern technical learning space also focused on technology and innovation. Our BIT lab includes up-to-date computer systems, specialized software, and networking technologies to create a perfect learning environment for coding, programming, data analysis, and cybersecurity practices. The separate high-tech labs used by students at Balmiki Lincoln College reflect our commitment to giving students an industry-relevant, career-focused education. Fully equipped science labs for Chemistry, Physics, Biology Advanced computer labs with high-speed internet and software Specialized workshops for engineering and practical training Dedicated research spaces with modern instruments Computer Labs Modern computer labs with updated hardware and software to support IT, programming, and digital studies. High-Speed Internet Science Labs Well-equipped Chemistry, Physics, and Biology labs for experiential learning and scientific experimentation. Practical Learning
